info.title: NOMA API
info.description: Portfolio e-commerce API. **Payments are simulated: no payment gateway exists and no card data is ever accepted.** Every response is wrapped as `{ success, data, timestamp }` (errors: `{ success: false, error, timestamp }`). Requests are rate limited per client address (429 + Retry-After). Generated from the running application.
